If it takes 5 machines 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, then each machine produces 1 widget in 5 minutes. This means the rate per machine is 1 widget every 5 minutes. 

Now, if there are 100 machines, each producing 1 widget in 5 minutes, then all 100 machines working simultaneously would produce 100 widgets in the same amount of time—5 minutes. The time required does not change because the number of widgets produced scales directly with the number of machines, assuming each machine works independently at the same rate.

**Answer:** It would take 5 minutes for 100 machines to make 100 widgets.
